cohort: The study cohort comprised 2.2 million singletons born in Denmark (1980-2010) and Wales (1998-2015), including 852 children identified with Cystic Fibrosis.
finding: Babies with Cystic Fibrosis were significantly more likely to be born preterm and with lower birth weight compared to those without CF, with approximately 40% of the birth weight effect mediated through shorter gestational age.
